_comment: English locale for Word Ladder. Keys (left) are fixed; translate only the values (right). Keep every {placeholder} verbatim. Word tokens ({start_word}, {target_word}, {word}, {current}, {ladder}) are neutral game words and must not be translated. Keep the bracket example `[word]` as-is.

_slots.{start_word}: The starting word of the ladder (neutral token)
_slots.{target_word}: The target word to reach (neutral token)
_slots.{word}: The word the player just submitted (neutral token)
_slots.{ladder}: The move history joined by ' -> ' (neutral tokens)
_slots.{history}: The rendered history line (already localized; do not translate)
_slots.{pct}: Percentage of letters shared with the target (integer)

prompt.intro:
Wena u Muthu {player_id}.  Kulondanga kwako ni kufikila kamba yotaka kwa kubadilisha **kamba moja pamo**.
- Kamba ya kuanza:  **{start_word}**
- Kamba yotaka: **{target_word}**
Tumishe kila mwendelezo mwa kamba mwenye mabano ya mraba, kwa mfano  `[word]`.
Londanga ya nyuma inaonekana pansi wakati wa kutha.  Nzelenga!

invalid.wrong_format: Mbano usiofaa. Fungila kamba yako mwenye mabano ya mraba, kwa mfano `[word]`.
invalid.wrong_length: `{word}` ina urefu usiofaa; kamba yotaka ni {target_len} kamba.

outcome.win: Hongera! Wena u fiki kamba yotaka.
outcome.turn_limit: Mwisho wa mwendelezo umefikiwa. Wena u fiki `{current}` ambayo inashiriki {pct}% ya kamba zake na kamba yotaka `{target}`.
